attributes.action: Make it mandatory for suicide prevention measures in bridges in the UK
attributes.additional_details: Suicide in the UK is the biggest killer of men under the age of 54. Around 20 people per day will Take their own life, 18 will be men. I know that ultimately when someone wants to take their life there are multiple ways to do it but I believe that we need to try and tackle those ways starting with bridges. There have been 6 jumpers this year in my Home town and we need to try and do everything we can to help these young people.
attributes.background: I want it to be mandatory to put prevention measures on all bridges in the UK. Signs for mental health services. Barriers. Nets. Whatever we can to stop people jumping from bridges.

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this which you may wish to sign:

Fund barriers and cameras to make bridges and motorways safer
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/778576
